gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant type tests are carried out on an appliance representing the product assessed.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared model is SPC55068, but the summary identifies 4TSC4.0-96-110/1000 as the model receiving full tests; equivalence is not established.
gaps.required_action: Identify the tested sample and provide a valid assessment of SPC55068.

gaps.normative_requirement: The appliance is marked with its rated voltage or rated voltage range.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared marking is 220–240 V, whereas the clause 7.1 entry records 96 V.
gaps.required_action: Reconcile the sample identification and rated-voltage marking using verified evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Power input is assessed against the marked rated power at rated voltage and normal operation.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared rating is 550 W, but the test table uses 1,000 W as the rated basis and records 995.2 W at 72 V.
gaps.required_action: Test and report the declared model against its verified 550 W rating.

gaps.normative_requirement: The particular part supplements or modifies the applicable general part.
gaps.finding_reason: The test specification claims IEC 60335-2-41:2025, while the compliance statement claims 2012; the claimed Part 1 amendments and the 2025 particular edition were not supplied. The supplied European particular standard also references A11:2021, which was not supplied.
gaps.required_action: Confirm the certification standard set and provide the claimed editions and amendments for assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable tests use the specified supply and voltage derived from the appliance rating.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared rating is 220–240 V, 50 Hz, while the particulars state DC and the heating and leakage tables use 76.3 V; these conditions do not establish the required tests for the declared rating.
gaps.required_action: Repeat the applicable tests using the verified supply and rated-voltage range of SPC55068.

gaps.normative_requirement: The stalled-motor test is performed at rated voltage for the applicable period.
gaps.finding_reason: The recorded locked-rotor voltage is 116.6 Vdc, inconsistent with the declared 220–240 V, 50 Hz rating; the test duration is not recorded.
gaps.required_action: Repeat the stalled-motor test at the verified rated supply and record the duration and results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Pump tests use liquid temperature related to the marked maximum, and the heating test uses liquid at that marked temperature.
gaps.finding_reason: The report states only that maximum liquid temperature is below 45 °C; the reproduced marking has no maximum temperature and no measured test-liquid temperature is recorded.
gaps.required_action: Provide the verified temperature marking and test-liquid records or repeat the heating assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: A submersible pump over 50 W is marked with maximum operating depth, and its IP number and maximum liquid temperature are marked.
gaps.finding_reason: The 550 W pump is reported as IP68, but the reproduced marking does not show IP68, operating depth or maximum liquid temperature; operating depth is recorded as N/A.
gaps.required_action: Provide the actual markings and verify the applicable marking requirements.

gaps.normative_requirement: Installation instructions state maximum total head for pumps rated above 50 W.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes this item by reference to the marking detail, but the reproduced marking gives no maximum total head and the installation instructions are not supplied.
gaps.required_action: Provide the installation instructions and record the maximum total head.

gaps.normative_requirement: Submersible pumps undergo the specified 24 h immersion at pressure determined by maximum operating depth.
gaps.finding_reason: A pass is recorded, but maximum operating depth and actual test pressure are absent; the report also refers to 5 m rather than the supplied standard’s 15 m alternative.
gaps.required_action: Provide the marked depth and actual immersion conditions, and repeat the test if the required pressure was not applied.

gaps.normative_requirement: Pumps undergo the specified dry-running sequence and meet the applicable abnormal-operation criteria.
gaps.finding_reason: The sequence is marked pass, but its test voltage, head, temperatures and post-test electric-strength results are not documented; the appended abnormal-temperature table identifies only 19.7.
gaps.required_action: Provide the complete 19.101 test record and associated 19.13 results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable thermal motor protectors are assessed with their motor under Annex D conditions.
gaps.finding_reason: The test-item particulars indicate a self-resetting thermal cut-out, but the automatic-control and Annex D entries are N/A without identifying the device or establishing whether it is needed for compliance.
gaps.required_action: Identify the cut-out and document its compliance assessment, including Annex D testing where required.

gaps.normative_requirement: Auxiliary-winding capacitors are assessed for their ratings and applicable locked-rotor fault conditions.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 24.5 records passes for a motor capacitor, while the capacitor fault tests under 19.7 are N/A and no capacitor is identified in the component table.
gaps.required_action: Establish whether an auxiliary-winding capacitor is fitted and provide its ratings and applicable fault-test results.

gaps.normative_requirement: A class I submersible pump is provided with a flexible supply cord fitted with a plug.
gaps.finding_reason: The pump is identified as class I and submersible, but the pump-specific cord and plug entries are N/A despite a general plug entry marked pass.
gaps.required_action: Verify the supplied cord and plug and correct the pump-specific assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: An outdoor class I submersible pump has the specified cord type and minimum cord length.
gaps.finding_reason: Outdoor use is selected in the particulars, but cord type, conductor area and outdoor cord length are not recorded and the relevant entries are N/A.
gaps.required_action: Identify and measure the supply cord and assess its type, conductor area and length against the applicable requirements.

gaps.normative_requirement: Pumps are tested as portable unless fixed, and applicable portable pumps undergo the cord-flexing test.
gaps.finding_reason: Neither portable nor fixed classification is selected, and the portable-pump flexing test is N/A without a documented fixed-appliance basis.
gaps.required_action: Establish the pump classification and perform the cord-flexing test if applicable.

gaps.normative_requirement: A class I supply cord has a correctly connected green/yellow earthing core, and the earthing conductor remains slack longer than current-carrying conductors.
gaps.finding_reason: The report identifies a class I appliance with a supply cord, but both checks are N/A without justification.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and record the earthing-core connections and conductor arrangement.

gaps.normative_requirement: Earthing continuity is tested at the specified current and the calculated resistance does not exceed 0.1 Ω.
gaps.finding_reason: A pass is recorded, but no measured resistance, test current or accessible parts tested are provided.
gaps.required_action: Record the test current and measured resistance for each applicable earthed part.

gaps.normative_requirement: Clearance and creepage assessments use the applicable rated impulse voltage, working voltage, pollution degree and material group.
gaps.finding_reason: The tables assess 500 V impulse and ≤50 V working voltage despite the declared 220–240 V rating; basic creepage is only recorded as greater than 2.0 mm, with pollution degree 3 selected and no material group identified.
gaps.required_action: Reassess each insulation path using verified voltages, material group and measured distances.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant non-metallic parts are assessed for heat and fire resistance using the applicable pump provisions.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 30 and its tests are N/A and the appended table is blank, although the component list includes an insulating bushing; the basis for excluding relevant parts is not documented.
gaps.required_action: Identify relevant non-metallic parts and provide applicable test results or substantiated exemptions.

gaps.normative_requirement: Report attribution must be reliable for the evidence to support the assessment.
gaps.finding_reason: PDF page 86 carries report number EN200622010S rather than EN201222034S, casting doubt on attribution of the creepage-table continuation.
gaps.required_action: Obtain a verified replacement page and confirm the integrity of the complete report.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: The report cannot support certification of SPC55068 in its present form. The model, rating and supply discrepancies undermine attribution of the reported results, while missing immersion, earthing, cord and heat-and-fire evidence prevents a complete assessment against the supplied standards.
final_summary.recommended_action: Obtain a verified replacement report based on the correctly identified SPC55068 and the confirmed applicable standard set, including all necessary test records and assessments.
